editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Swissquote is a FINMA-licensed Swiss bank listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange, scoring 7.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. This is not a typical retail broker — it is a full banking institution offering trading services alongside Swiss IBAN accounts and CHF 100,000 deposit protection. Spreads are wider than ECN competitors, and the CHF 1,000 minimum is a barrier, but the regulatory safety is unmatched. Best for traders who prioritise Swiss banking security above spread cost.
